{"code": "import pandas as pd

# Deduplicate: keep highest sample_seq per patient_id
trial_df_dedup = trial_df.sort_values('sample_seq', ascending=False).drop_duplicates(subset='patient_id', keep='first')

# Replace sentinel values with NaN
sentinel_values = [-999.0, -999, -999.00, -999.000]
trial_df_dedup['biomarker_baseline'] = trial_df_dedup['biomarker_baseline'].replace(sentinel_values, pd.NA)
trial_df_dedup['biomarker_final'] = trial_df_dedup['biomarker_final'].replace(sentinel_values, pd.NA)

# Check the result
print(f'Data shape after deduplication and sentinel replacement: {trial_df_dedup.shape}')
print(f'Number of missing biomarker_baseline: {trial_df_dedup["biomarker_baseline"].isna().sum()}')
print(f'Number of missing biomarker_final: {trial_df_dedup["biomarker_final"].isna().sum()}')

# Check for any remaining sentinel values
if trial_df_dedup['biomarker_baseline'].isin(sentinel_values).any() or trial_df_dedup['biomarker_final'].isin(sentinel_values).any():
    note_finding('Sentinel values remain after replacement.',
                 'IMPLICATION: This is a data issue. We must check the replacement logic.')
else:
    print('All sentinel values successfully replaced with NaN.')"}
